_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

agreement.claim: both engines report the same F statistic, pooled SD, pairwise differences and Tukey bounds
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0 at ten decimals except the Tukey bounds, which differ by 3.0e-10 because R's qtukey and scipy's studentized_range integrate the studentized range distribution independently. harness/comparisons_examples.test.py rebuilds the bounds from the studentized range quantile and the pooled variance, and shows that a numeric arm column changes F from 94.1 to 176.6.

recovery.claim: the pairwise differences and pooled SD are close to the values the fixture was built with

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: Measured by harness/comparisons_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 of this generator.
